title: Temperature Converter
description: Convert temperatures between Fahrenheit and Celsius using formulas and build a converter object.

steps.title: Convert Fahrenheit to Celsius
steps.description: Write an `fToC` function that converts Fahrenheit to Celsius using the formula `(f - 32) * 5 / 9`.
hints: The function takes a Fahrenheit value and returns the Celsius equivalent

verification.failureMessage: fToC(32) should return 0 and fToC(212) should return 100.

steps.title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
steps.description: Write a `cToF` function that converts Celsius to Fahrenheit using the formula `(c * 9 / 5) + 32`.

verification.failureMessage: cToF(0) should return 32 and cToF(100) should return 212.

steps.title: Temperature converter object
steps.description: Create a `Temperature` object (or class) with methods for both conversions and store the current value.
hints: Create an object with a celsius property and both conversion methods
The fToC and cToF methods can reuse your existing functions

verification.successMessage: The temperature object logs both units!
verification.failureMessage: The log method should show celsius and fahrenheit with degree symbols.

steps.title: Convert multiple temperatures
steps.description: Use a loop to convert an array of Fahrenheit temperatures to Celsius.
hints: Create an array of Fahrenheit values
Loop through and convert each one
Print each result on its own line

codeTemplate.python:
def fToC(f):
  return (f - 32) * 5 / 9

temps = [32, 50, 68, 86, 104, 212]
# Loop through temps and print each conversion

verification.successMessage: All Fahrenheit temperatures converted to Celsius!

steps.title: Format results with labels
steps.description: Format each conversion result as a string like `"68°F = 20°C"` and print all of them.
hints: Use string concatenation or template literals to combine the values
Round to 1 decimal place if needed using .toFixed(1) or round()
Print the formatted string for each conversion

verification.successMessage: Beautifully formatted temperature conversions with both units!
verification.failureMessage: Each line should show both the Fahrenheit and Celsius values with degree symbols.
